name: Qwen3-VL-Embedding (2B, 8B)
usage: Search images and text by meaning

runtimes.value: sentence-transformers (official library tag; text and image) or own Qwen3VLEmbedder script with transformers >= 4.57, qwen-vl-utils, torch 2.8 (MPS unverified); MLX via mlx-embeddings with mlx-community 2B builds only (4-8 bit, bf16, mxfp/nvfp4), 8B only community (jedisct1, nkamiy); llama.cpp: community GGUFs, text mode with --embeddings --pooling last, images need mtmd; a crash report (#18910) closed stale. Ollama: community tags only (e.g. charaf/qwen3-vl-embedding-8b)
runtimes.note: Image embeddings through llama.cpp or Ollama are not confirmed; a Jina article says upstream llama.cpp lacks multimodal embedding output (other model). vLLM/SGLang examples are CUDA. Thin evidence for any Mac run.

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026: Hacker News comments only (Algolia API). Reddit, Hugging Face discussions and runtime issues not read yet. Removed on 15.11.2026: a remark that Qwen3-VL-Embedding is the newest Qwen embedding family, not user feedback.
web.summary: No feedback yet. Useful only if the assistant must search photos or scanned documents by meaning; otherwise Qwen3-Embedding is enough.
